name: Topic hijacks a knowledge question
symptom: How many open Emergency work orders are there? starts Log Field Request and asks for an asset ID instead of answering 4 from Dataverse
cause: Greedy topic description (generative orchestration) or matching trigger phrase (classic orchestration) wins over knowledge; topic and trigger counts undocumented
fix: Narrow the topic description to what it does and does not do; remove broad trigger phrases; re-test knowledge questions after adding topics

name: Topic variable out of scope
symptom: Crew For Asset cannot see the asset from Check Asset Status when it reads Topic.AssetId; answer is wrong or it asks again
cause: Topic variables exist only in the topic that defines them; a same-named variable in another topic is a new empty variable
fix: Use a global variable (Global.LastAssetId) or pass the value as a topic input

name: Glossary not applied yet
symptom: Right after adding the glossary, WO-2026-01076 (RCL lockout on OH line, Ontario asset RCL-ON-13307) may still be described as an Ohio issue
cause: Dataverse knowledge glossary and synonym updates can take up to 15 minutes to apply; OH is both a region code and an abbreviation
fix: Wait up to 15 minutes and re-test in a fresh conversation; write glossary entries that resolve ambiguity

name: Synonym collision
symptom: Observe: with ticket number as a Work Order Number synonym, questions about Lab 7 ticket 104321 search work orders; tickets also maps to crew Certifications
cause: Synonyms widen column matching; one word mapped to two columns and another system is ambiguous; each added table (up to 15) adds more names
fix: Remove ambiguous synonyms; add only words users use for that column; describe the ticket connector source distinctly in Lab 7

name: Tabular aggregates over the Vendors list
symptom: Observe: High risk and Active count below 176 (144 in first 2,048 rows); largest contract reported as Mohawk Valley instead of Northgate
cause: List knowledge queries use the first 2,048 rows; generative answers summarize retrieved rows rather than aggregating the whole list
fix: Use Dataverse or a filtered query action for counts and totals; have the agent state how many records it used

name: Approval matrix docx vs xlsx
symptom: Without the authority instruction, a CAD 120,000 consulting engagement is routed to Director (stale xlsx 150,000) instead of VP (docx 75,000)
cause: Approval-Matrix.xlsx cell D8 is stale; docx v3.2 reduced the limit; content issue, no product limit
fix: Instruct the agent that the docx is authoritative; fix or remove the stale xlsx

name: Developer environment is owner-only
symptom: Observe: Marcus cannot be given access to HLE-Dev Dataverse and gets no Dataverse answers; the learner does
cause: Developer environments are owner-only and cannot be assigned security groups
fix: Author in HLE-Dev but test multi-user scenarios in a Sandbox or Production environment with a security role (Lab 11 HLE-Test, HLE-Prod)

name: Regex entity misses variants
symptom: Observe: TX ON 10423 and 4-digit IDs are not extracted and the question re-prompts; lowercase behavior undocumented
cause: Regex entity matches only what the pattern allows (uppercase codes, hyphens, 5 digits)
fix: Decide accepted variants; add case handling if supported (check Learn); keep rejecting invalid lengths; show the format in the re-prompt
